players.bio: Alan Godoy Domínguez (born 4 May 2003) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays for CD Eldense. Mainly a forward, he can also play as a left winger.

Alan Nahuel Ruiz (born 19 August 1993) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Portuguese Primeira Liga club Estrela da Amadora. International career He was called in 2011 for the Argentina U-20 National Team, as part of the squad that played on the 2011 FIFA U-20 World Cup.

Ianis Ilie Stoica (Romanian pronunciation: ; born 8 December 2002) is a Romanian professional footballer who plays as a forward or an attacking midfielder for Liga I club Hermannstadt. Club career Early career Stoica started his career in 2009 in the academy of Petrolul Ploiești, the same year his father Pompiliu signed a professional contract with the club.

Joan Jordán is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for the Portuguese Primeira Liga club C.F. Estrela da Amadora. He joined the side in August 2026 on a free transfer following a long spell with Sevilla FC.
Lovro Zvonarek (born 8 May 2005) is a Croatian professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Swiss Super League side Grasshopper, on loan from Bundesliga club Bayern Munich.
Luan Patrick Wiedthäuper (born 20 January 2002), known as Luan Patrick, is a Brazilian footballer who plays as a central defender for Italian Serie A side Hellas Verona.
Luís Rafael Soares Alves (born 9 May 1995), commonly known as Rafa, is a Portuguese footballer who plays as a left back for Spanish club SD Eibar on loan from Vitória de Guimarães.

Renan Ribeiro (born 23 March 1990) is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper, most recently for Portuguese club Sporting CP. He began his career in the Campeonato Brasileiro Série A with Atlético Mineiro and São Paulo. In January 2018 he moved to Portugal, where he represented Estoril and Sporting CP in the Primeira Liga.
